_comment: Released 6 m / 4 cm recipe retrained on every labelled block of the 15 training bridges.
bridge_w6 holds out 20% of the blocks for validation and early stopping; the benchmark
baselines were trained without a validation set. This recipe folds the held-out blocks back
into training (--val_in_train), fixes the epoch count so nothing depends on the in-sample
validation numbers, and keeps every other setting of bridge_w6. Use final_model.pth.
name: bridge_w6_all
description: 6 m window at 4 cm voxels, trained on all labelled blocks
